notes.title: 🚀 Mechanic Beyond the Horizon – Roadmap & Future Plans! 🌌
notes.notes:
Hey, Mechanics! We're thrilled by your interest in Mechanic Beyond the Horizon! You can now add the game to your Wishlist on Steam, check out the gameplay trailer and screenshots, and stay updated on our development progress. We’re working on a demo, which will be available once it's ready. Plus, our crowdfunding campaign has launched on Indiegogo, where you can support the project and receive exclusive rewards!


Today, we're excited to share our roadmap, showing what to expect in the upcoming updates!

🛠️ Phase 1 – Demo Polish (Q2 2025)  
• Gameplay Optimization: Bug fixes, mechanic balancing, and UX improvements.  
• More Ships: Expanding the range of vessels that can visit the station.  
• Economic System Overhaul: Adjusting prices, resources, and maintenance costs.  
• Technical Enhancements: UI refinements, animation updates, and improved object physics.  
📢 After this phase, the demo will be available to play!

🌍 Phase 2 – Content Expansion (Q3 2025)  
• New Events: Introducing random scenarios (malfunctions, accidents, pirate threats).  
• Station Customization: New modules, upgrades, and expansion opportunities.  
• Factional Orders: Unique missions from military, merchants, and pirates that affect your reputation.  
• Advanced Repairs: More detailed engineering tasks.  

🚀 Phase 3 – Preparing for Release (Q4 2025)  
• Final Balancing: Gameplay tweaks based on player feedback.  
• Expanded Universe: New systems and stations to explore and interact with.  
• Advanced Technologies: Discover alien tech and introduce new mechanics.  
• Story Missions: Unique quest chains with exclusive rewards.  

🔥 We couldn’t do this without you! Support us on Indiegogo and help us add even more content. Yes, even $3 brings us closer to the release!  

💡 Add to your Wishlist, follow the news, and get ready for the demo release! 🚀
